title: The Third Veil
author: a Choirmaster
pages: To the Veiled of each cell, from the Choir above. Read once, learn, and burn. The outer chorus is to know nothing of what follows. Kindness is their door. Keep it open.
In famine, set the Quiet Table. Feed all who come and ask nothing. When they ask why, say: because no one else did. It is true, and the truth binds better than any oath.
Take the dead no one remembers. Let candles fail. Buy wax before the Honey Lane closes and sell none. Every cold grave is a voice for the chorus and a crack in the Jailer's chains.
Teach the chorus to stop sleeping. The sleepless dream into Her mouth. The mares will not trouble our own. They know whose they are.
When the Jailer falls, as she will to some proud fool's sword, the Last Ember will appear. Do not let it be rekindled. Bring it below, to the Halls where the hush grows, to the Door without light.
The Door wants a light to swallow. Give it the last one. Then there will be no more dawns to grieve, and we who sing will be the only kings in the long and gentle dark.
